name: [🏝️SUMMER🏝️] Scary Baboon Ultimate
desc:
🔨 This game is still in BETA! Expect bugs!🔨

Welcome to Scary Baboon Ultimate, a remastered version of Scary Baboon VR where you can...

🗺️ Explore the MASSIVE Map!

😱 Escape Monsters!

🎵 Listen to the Scary Baboon Soundtrack! 

🎩 Buy or earn Cosmetics!

🔫 Go to different game-modes!

------CONTROLS------
Recommended to play in First Person 
(Zoom in) 
Press C or CTRL on PC and R2 on Controller to slide
Press B on PC and R1 on Controller to open the emotes menu
Press R on PC to unlock mouse
Shift for Shiftlock
Press the Chat icon under the normal Chat to Quick Chat (Credits to Festivereinhard2 for it)

-----DISCLAIMER-----
This game is NOT affiliated, endorsed or made by kj1, bick or stepper this is simply a fangame.
